$comment: Hand-edited thresholds for the performance workbench (perf/README.md). baseline.json holds the measured draw-call baseline and is rewritten by `npm run perf:update`.

frame.$comment: p95 cost of one frame (update + draw + raster) in software-rendered headless Chromium at 1600x800. 16.7 ms is a whole 60 fps frame.

regression.$comment: Against the base branch, measured on the same machine in the same run. A case fails only when it is both this much slower in % and in ms.

drawCalls.$comment: Drawing calls per frame may grow this much over baseline.json before failing.

bundle.$comment: Gzipped JS + CSS the app ships (sampled Tones' MP3s excluded: they load on demand).
